findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context returns unmodified monitor config
findings.body: The function copies monitor_environment.monitor.config into the local variable `config` and conditionally updates `schedule_type` to its display value, but then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original, unmodified dict) instead of `config`. As a result, the occurrence context contains the raw schedule_type value rather than the human-readable display. This appears to be an accidental leftover from the move; the function should return `config`.
